corrections.intro: Schedule corrections are suggested by students and apply on their own once they reach 3 confirmations and more confirmations than rejections. This panel is a safety net: you can apply a pending one right away or reject one (if it was applied, it reverts to the SGA schedule). Corrections are anonymous.

status.SUPERSEDED: Superseded (the SGA changed or another correction was applied)

corrections.rejectBody: The correction for {{subject}} · Commission {{commission}} will be rejected and won't apply even if it keeps getting votes.
corrections.revertBody: {{subject}} · Commission {{commission}} will go back to showing the SGA schedule in the Schedule Builder. The correction is rejected and won't re-apply by votes.
corrections.appliedNotice: Done: the correction for {{subject}} · Commission {{commission}} is now used in the Schedule Builder.
corrections.rejectedNotice: Done: you rejected the correction for {{subject}} · Commission {{commission}}.
corrections.revertedNotice: Done: {{subject}} · Commission {{commission}} is back on the SGA schedule.
corrections.conflict: This correction changed state in the meantime (votes, the SGA sync or another staff member). The list was reloaded with its current state.
corrections.emptyHint: This is where schedules that students propose to fix from the Schedule Builder will show up. Normally you don't need to do anything: each correction applies on its own once enough other students confirm it.

departments.subtitle: Six departments coordinate everything CEITBA does for the ITBA community: from technology and communications to sports and student representation.

benefits.subtitle: Access to sports, exclusive discounts, events, academic support and student representation. Filter by category in the Benefits tab.

cta.title: Want to be part of it?
cta.body: Whether you'd like to join a team, pitch a project, or raise a topic that matters to you — get in touch. CEITBA is open to the whole ITBA community.
